BrochureContent.Content:
Property Partners Buggy are delighted to present to the market this charming 3 bedroom detached bungalow situated in Beladd Upper in Portlaoise. This well-maintained property enjoys a convenient location within walking distance of all local amenities and offers comfortable living accommodation throughout. This home has been lovingly cared for and benefits from off-street parking to the front.

The property is further enhanced by mature, well-kept gardens to both the front and rear, providing a private and peaceful outdoor space. A detached shed offers excellent storage or workshop potential.

Accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, spacious kitchen/dining area, utility room, sitting room, family bathroom, living room, porch to the rear and three generously sized bedrooms . This attractive home will appeal to a wide range of purchasers including first-time buyers, those looking to downsize, and investors alike. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.
